metadata.note: The engine SPI, expressed over HTTP because that is the shape a networked binding receives; an in-process binding satisfies the same expectations with the same bodies. Four rules are load-bearing: a write to a fenced scope is refused with FENCED_WRITE rather than accepted or dropped; a capture read returns changes in commit order and does not consume them; a digest carries counts and digests only, never a record; and a native transfer's ticket names where the records are without carrying a credential or a record, while a transfer the engine cannot do faithfully is refused with NATIVE_TRANSFER_REFUSED rather than approximated. test/pact.test.ts replays every interaction against the reference engine, and the conformance kit holds every other engine to the same behaviour.
